concepts.way: diagnose_an_error (fix for the one given failing case; L4 boundary)
concepts.quote: You need System.exit(0) at the end of main.
concepts.why: The answer gives the right fix for this failing case: a StdAudio program should end main with System.exit(0). But the L4 boundary says fixing one given failing case is L3, and the answer does not explain the cause.
The answer says nothing about end of input or StdIn.isEmpty().
